_about: Lane marks for andrewssobral/simple_vehicle_counting dataset/video.avi (320x176). Clicked on the median of 60 frames (the empty road). Two eastbound lanes between the yellow median line (y = 0) and the kerb line (y = -7), divider dashes on y = -3.5; lane width 3.5 m assumed. No stop line or zebra in view, so shear is gauge-pinned (harmless to speeds and to per-lane counts). Dash period unknown: use --fleet-scale.
